summary: Apply lifecycle costing, climate criteria, and contract KPIs to procurement decisions. Explore the practical five-day course.
lede: Sustainable public procurement training helps teams assess bids for value and sustainability. It is for public procurement officers, donor-funded project teams, category managers, sustainability officers, and bid-evaluation committee members, who practise lifecycle-cost comparisons, climate evidence criteria, and transparent scoring. They also learn to connect evaluated commitments to supplier KPIs and contract monitoring, using ISO 20400 and the GHG Protocol as reference points.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who write, evaluate, approve, or monitor procurement decisions involving public funds, donor financing, sustainability criteria, or supplier performance.
modules: Lifecycle Costing and Value for Money
prerequisites: Relevant experience in procurement, project delivery, sustainability, tender evaluation, or contract management is recommended. No coding is required; exercises use procurement documents, cost worksheets, and evaluation scenarios.
